name: sym
displayName: sym — read the function, not the file
description: Read the function, not the file. A mod: whole-file Reads of big source files come back as symbol skeletons, the repo map arrives with your first message, and map/ls/read/find (and a semantic where) are tools. Rust, Lua, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C, C++, Java, Ruby. Needs the sym binary (cargo install sym-cli) and Claude Code 2.1.287+ for the mod; older clients get the classic hint hook.

read_mode.title: Read mode
read_mode.description: What happens when Claude Reads a whole source file over min_lines: skeleton (answer with the symbol skeleton), hint (let it through and append the skeleton), or off.

min_lines.title: Minimum lines
min_lines.description: Source files with more lines than this come back as a skeleton.

map_budget.title: Repo map budget
map_budget.description: Approximate tokens for the repo map sent with the first message.

index_url.title: Embeddings endpoint
index_url.description: An OpenAI-compatible base URL whose /v1/embeddings embeds code (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8440). Empty disables the semantic `where` tool.

index_model.title: Embedding model
index_model.description: Model name sent to the embeddings endpoint (optional).
